sub_sections.title: Introduction:
sub_sections.description_text:
[u][b]Notes:[/b][/u]
There are 30 audio logs in total. The first 29 are located in Mombasa city and can be collected in any order throughout the Rookie sections of the campaign. However, if you complete
the campaign first, a final rally a final rally point for Mombasa streets called "Open Streets" will be unlocked. I recommend collecting the first 29 audio logs using this rally point
as all sections of the city are open. After you have collected the first 29 audio logs, load up the Data Hive mission. Progress through the level as normal and you will meet up with
a police offer. Continue with him until you reach a frozen area and he tells you to stay put. Instead follow him into a room, at which point he will turn hostile. Kill him and the
final audio log will be on the wall.
